title: Stairlift Service Readiness Service Due-Soon Queue
dataSources: Mobility-aid status (`mobilityaid:status`), wheelchair battery telemetry (`wheelchair:battery`), stairlift service records (`stairlift:service`), hearing-aid battery records (`hearingaid:battery`), pendant-alert tests (`pendant:test`).
app: Wheelchair battery telemetry, stairlift service records, hearing-aid battery reminders, and pendant-alert test logs streamed to Splunk HEC via apps, service portals, and caregiver forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=stairlift:service
| eval days_to_service=round((next_service_epoch-now())/86400,1)
| where days_to_service>=0 AND days_to_service<=30
| table _time stairlift_id home_area days_to_service
| sort days_to_service
description: Builds a queue of stairlift service readiness equipment with service or replacement due in the next month.
value: Service-due reminders keep support equipment dependable without relying on memory alone.
implementation: Feed the next service or replacement date from the vendor portal, care plan, or your own checklist export.
visualization: Table of devices ordered by days until service.
grandmaExplanation: It surfaces which stairlift service readiness items need servicing soon.
